Antrix was set up in September 1992 as a private limited company and became a Miniratna in 2008; its supply-driven model covered marketing ISRO products, transponder leasing, remote-sensing data and consultancy; NSIL follows the demand-driven model of owning satellites against committed demand.

All four are listed as measurable by remote sensing: surface and groundwater prospects, snow and glaciers, wetlands, and mineral/hydrocarbon zones (along with land cover, vegetation, soil and crop yield). So D.

All three are correct: City Flood Alert was built by RTGS with APSDMA and IIT Gandhinagar, is an AI-based urban flood-forecasting platform, and gives 48-hour rainfall and 6-hour flash-flood warnings (first in Vijayawada). So D.

Nagayalanka in coastal Krishna district is the site of DRDO's planned missile test range for flight trials of tactical missiles. NSTL Visakhapatnam is the naval weapons lab, the ADA flight-testing complex is in Sri Sathya Sai district, and the CBRN Field Training Centre is in Delhi.

Nag, HELINA (helicopter-launched Nag) and MPATGM are the listed fire-and-forget anti-tank missiles. Akash Prime is a surface-to-air missile (upgraded Akash Mk-I with an active RF seeker), not one of the fire-and-forget ATGMs. So C.

Nag Mk-2 (NAMIS) is the tracked fire-and-forget 'tank killer' approved for Army procurement. Dhruvastra is the helicopter-launched Nag for the IAF (the ship-launched Prithvi is Dhanush); SANT is an air-launched stand-off ATGM with Lock-On After Launch (HELINA is the Army Aviation version); MPATGM is a man-portable Nag-family ATGM, not an Akash variant.
